a115.name: CUT-A
a115.label: sglang-fcfs-r1-cut-a115
a115.rule: per counted seed: UNSTUCK if the run is not STUCK on the frozen evaluation window (it counts against the theory); otherwise THEORY-FAVOURED iff |S - S_theory| < |S - S_naive| and |S - S_qs| (S the measured slope of N over [3000, 8700) s), NAIVE-FAVOURED (QS-FAVOURED) iff S_naive (S_qs) is strictly the closest, TIE otherwise; CUT-A PASS iff THEORY-FAVOURED in >= 2 of the 3 registered seeds and the slope of N over [5700, 8700) s is > 0 in >= 2 of the 3; FAIL iff NAIVE-FAVOURED, QS-FAVOURED or UNSTUCK in >= 2 of the 3 together; else MIXED; a run counts only if it is the registered cell's (label sglang-fcfs-r1-cut-a115, arm burst, rate_mult 1.65, a registered seed), completed (not aborted), bound to this registration (analysis.prereg.run_blockers empty) and its manipulation check passes
